libSceAgc.sprx.source: Store set 4 libSceAgc (07a995b3, J03828141 FW 12.70) with the SDK4 AcquireMem workaround forced to mode 2: VA 0x8c23 (file 0xcc23) 'mov eax, esi; nop' -> 'push 2; pop rax' (6a 02 58). Mode 2 clears GL1_RANGE when GLV_INV and range bit 3 are both set, no packet-size change; FINDINGS 6u. Not console-tested. | Since 2026-10-17 (FINDINGS 6v): from 9ec2512f, sceKernelIsTrinityMode turned back from local definitions into imports (st_shndx 0, as in Sony's file) with the GOT pre-filled with the former local stub: native wherever the firmware exports them (IsTrinityMode/HasTrinityMode 7.00, _Mtx_* 9.00, GetOperationMode 11.00), the old stub elsewhere. Not console-tested. | 2026-10-17 second pass (FINDINGS 6v): from 2954e19c, the Pro queries eSgYzXvTPQI and ciYlptMdvhc (libkernel, from 9.00; used by sceAgcGetRegisterDefaults*) restored from local definitions to imports with the former stub as GOT pre-fill (fakelib restore-imports). Not console-tested.
